1.Applying Properties of Big-O?

Consider the following statement.

If f(x)=3e2x+2x, then f=O(e2x) as x→∞.

A proof of the statement is given below

L1:f=O(3e2x+2x)

L2:limx→∞(2x3e2x)=0

L3:2x=O(3e2x)

L4:f=O(3e2x)

L5:f=O(e2x)
